entities.summary: Trevor Hudgins is an American professional basketball player for Le Mans of the LNB Élite. He played college basketball for the Northwest Missouri State Bearcats where he led the team to three consecutive NCAA Division II championships. Hudgins was named as the NABC Division II Player of the Year in 2021 and 2022 and the Mid-America Intercollegiate Athletics Association (MIAA) Player of the Year from 2020 to 2022, making him one of the most decorated players in NCAA Division II history.
